import json, random, sys, collections, time
sys.path.insert(0,"tmp"); sys.path.insert(0,"submission")
import gen, gen2, gen3, ref, main as M
bad=0; t0=time.time(); gens=(gen.rand_doc, gen2.make, gen3.make)
st=collections.Counter(); dec=collections.Counter(); mx=0
for s in range(9000):
    rng=random.Random(900000+s)
    doc = gens[s%3](rng)
    got = M.replay(M.validate(doc))
    exp = ref.solve(json.loads(json.dumps(doc)))
    if exp!=got:
        bad+=1; print("MISMATCH",s); json.dump(doc,open("tmp/badY_%d.json"%s,"w"))
        if bad>2: break
    for j in got["jobs"]: st[j["status"]]+=1
    for p in got["packets"]: dec[p["decision"]]+=1
    mx=max(mx,len(got["jobs"]))
print("bad",bad,dict(st),dict(dec),"maxjobs",mx,"%.1fs"%(time.time()-t0))
EOF
